text.tspan: 바로 표시하고 UI에서 편집할 수 있도록 5대 핵심 MoE 속성을 명시적으로 재정의(:>>)함.

^phase1To2GateCheck : Phase1ToPhase2GateConstraint { in :>> presentations = accumulatedPresentationsCount; in :>> refModels = completedReferenceModelsCount; in :>> aiSkills = developedAISkillsCount; in :>> activeMembers = regularActiveMembersCount; in :>> sepMembers = sepCertifiedMembersCount; }

^phase2To3GateCheck : Phase2ToPhase3GateConstraint { in :>> presentations = accumulatedPresentationsCount; in :>> refModels = completedReferenceModelsCount; in :>> aiSkills = developedAISkillsCount; in :>> activeMembers = regularActiveMembersCount; in :>> sepMembers = sepCertifiedMembersCount; }
